7`) (7) straight -> lane_change_urban: label `dist_to_front<15 && extra_lane=true`, required guard 'dist_to_front<15 and extra_lane=true' (PlantUML line 35: `straight --> lane_change_urban : dist_to_front<15 && extra_lane=true`) (8) collision_avoidance_active -> collision_avoidance_deactive: label `front_inactive && rear_inactive && pedestrian_inactive`, required guard 'front_inactive and rear_inactive and pedestrian_inactive' (PlantUML line 48: `collision_avoidance_active --> collision_avoidance_deactive : front_inactive && rear_inactive && pedestrian_inactive`) In PlantUML a label without brackets is the trigger;
the closed model therefore declares one opaque event named after each condition and none of these transitions has a guard.
